subject: SOC 2 artifact: penetration test redaction plan + GRC upload
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@solsticehealth.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: grc-uploads@solsticehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Redacted penetration test artifact + SIG/CAIQ mapping for SOC 2 upload

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. As part of our SOC 2 evidence submission, compliance flagged that we need the most recent penetration test deliverable uploaded to our GRC portal. Two asks from our side:

- A redacted penetration test PDF that removes sensitive customer identifiers and exact internal IPs (we can accept hostname-level redaction).
- A simple mapping sheet showing where the pen-test findings map to SIG/CAIQ control IDs (we use a one-row-per-finding format).

Can you confirm:
1) whether Redwood can provide a redacted report (PDF) and a mapping spreadsheet?
2) expected turnaround for redaction and upload? We’d like the artifact in the portal by Nov 10 COB PT.
3) if you require any extra paperwork (NDA addendum, PoA) to allow us to accept the evidence in our portal.

Thanks — this is a blocking item for a mid-Nov compliance deadline. If easier, we can accept a redacted summary + a redaction map and then you can provide the full (non-redacted) report under an NDA for escrow.

Best,
Alice Chen
Security Compliance Manager
Solstice Health

Attachment: compliance_evidence_template_v3.xlsx (uploaded to request portal)

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-07T11:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redacted penetration test artifact + SIG/CAIQ mapping for SOC 2 upload

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask and timeline.

Short answer: yes, we can provide a redacted PDF plus the mapping spreadsheet and upload both to your GRC portal by Nov 10 COB PT. Plan below:

1) Redaction approach: we will redact customer identifiers, full IP addresses (leave /24 or hostname level), and any sensitive configuration snippets. Our security team will prepare a redaction map (CSV) that lists original artifact locations and redaction rationale.

2) Deliverables:
- redwood_pen_test_summary_redacted_v1.pdf (redacted summary suitable for GRC)
- redaction_map_v1.csv (field: original_path, redacted_value, rationale)
- sig_caiaq_mapping_20261107.xlsx (one-row-per-finding mapping to SIG/CAIQ control IDs)

3) Timeline:
- Draft redaction + mapping: by Nov 9 17:00 PT
- Internal review (legal & security): Nov 9 evening
- Upload to Solstice GRC portal: target Nov 10 13:00 PT (will notify once complete)

4) Paperwork: Mina (cc’d) will confirm whether you need an NDA addendum or if your portal terms suffice. Our posture: we can provide the full unredacted report to your legal under standard mutual NDA / secure transfer, but the redacted PDF should satisfy SOC 2 evidence upload.

I’ll get Marissa to run the redaction process and Karthik will help with the SIG/CAIQ mapping.

Action items for us: Marissa — can you take lead on redaction? Karthik — can you start the mapping with the latest findings export (I’ve attached the working copies). Mina — can you confirm paperwork needs?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redaction_map_v1.csv, sig_caiaq_mapping_20261107.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-07T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redacted penetration test artifact + SIG/CAIQ mapping for SOC 2 upload

On 2026-11-07 11:07, aditya.rao@redwood.com wrote:
> I’ll get Marissa to run the redaction process and Karthik will help with the SIG/CAIQ mapping.

Thanks — I’ll take ownership of the redaction. Notes for the runbook:

- Exclude proof-of-concept exploit snippets that include customer XIDs; where possible replace with a short behavioral summary (e.g., "authentication bypass demonstrated via misconfigured header") so the control narrative remains clear for auditors.
- Do not redact the finding severity, impacted component (e.g., auth-service), or remediation steps — auditors need those.
- For any findings tied to third-party integrations (S3 buckets, external APIs), flag them in the redaction_map so Solstice can request deeper evidence if needed.

I’ll produce two artifacts: a single consolidated redacted PDF and a redaction_map.csv with row-level pointers. Karthik — when you map to SIG/CAIQ, please include the exact control IDs in column A and reference the finding id in column B. Use the spreadsheet template Aditya attached.

Estimated completion (drafts): Nov 9 16:00 PT. I’ll also create a short memo describing the redaction rules to attach in portal (helps the auditor).

Marissa Cole
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_pen_test_summary_redacted_v1.pdf (draft — internal), redaction_map_v1.csv

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@solsticehealth.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: grc-uploads@solsticehealth.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-08T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifact: penetration test redaction plan + GRC upload

Aditya / Marissa / Mina — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear plan. Nov 10 COB PT works for us. A couple of quick confirmations:

- We prefer the redacted PDF + redaction_map.csv uploaded to the portal rather than a Drive link; please use the GRC portal upload and then paste the confirmation URL to this thread.
- For SIG/CAIQ mapping, the auditor wants explicit CAIQ control references where applicable (column heading: CAIQ_ID).
- No additional NDA addendum required for the redacted artifact; we’ll request the unredacted report via our legal channel if/when needed.

Please notify the grc-uploads address when the files are live and include a short note describing what was redacted (matching the redaction_map).

Appreciate the coordination.

Best,
Alice Chen
Security Compliance Manager
Solstice Health

GRC Portal: https://grc.solsticehealth.com/uploads/record?acct=solstice-00077
Requested due date: 2026-11-10 COB PT
